help.title: How to play IdleRPG
help.intro: IdleRPG is a game about doing as little as possible. Stay online, avoid penalties, and your character progresses automatically.
help.register.name: Getting started
help.register.value: Use `/idlerpg register` with a character name and class. Your Discord account owns one character in this channel; games in other configured channels are completely separate. No login command or password is needed.
help.progression.name: Levels and progression
help.progression.value: Your next-level timer counts down only while your character is active. At zero, you gain a level and receive a new, longer timer. Level-ups can also find equipment and trigger a duel. Use `/idlerpg status`, `/idlerpg whoami`, or `/idlerpg leaderboard` to follow your progress.
help.combat.name: Battles and random events
help.combat.value: Characters can duel after leveling, collide while moving around the map, or enter team battles. Equipment determines combat strength. Winning removes time from your clock; losing adds time. Critical strikes add time to an opponent, and some battles swap equipment. Godsends help, while calamities hurt.
help.items.name: Equipment and artifacts
help.items.value: Characters have ten equipment slots. Higher item levels increase your item score and combat rolls. Better items can be found on level-up; weaker finds are discarded. Some battles exchange items, and random events may improve or damage them. A ★ marks a unique artifact. Use `/idlerpg items` for the compact list or `/idlerpg status` for full details.
help.alignment.name: Alignment
help.alignment.value: Use `/idlerpg align` to become Good, Neutral, or Evil. Good characters receive a 10% combat-item bonus but score critical strikes less often. Evil characters receive a 10% combat-item penalty but score critical strikes more often. Alignment also unlocks special goodness and evilness events.
help.quests.name: Quests
help.quests.value: High-level active characters may be chosen automatically for a timed quest or a journey across map checkpoints. Completing one removes 25% of every participant's remaining time. A quest participant receiving a normal activity penalty fails the quest and penalizes all active players. Use `/idlerpg quest` to check progress.
help.penalties.name: Activity and offline penalties
help.penalties.value: Sending a normal message adds time based on its length and your level; changing your server nickname also adds time. Slash commands are safe. Going offline for more than {graceSeconds} seconds applies the original quit penalty and makes you inactive. Returning online reactivates you automatically. If presence tracking is unavailable, leaving the server is the fallback. Higher levels make penalties larger.
help.commands.name: Player commands
help.commands.value: `register` create a character • `status` inspect a character • `whoami` show your identity and timer • `quest` show the active quest • `align` change alignment • `items` list equipment • `leaderboard` show rankings • `removeme` permanently delete your character • `help` show this guide
